svg.title: What downsampling deletes, step by step
svg.desc: The same face at 24 by 24, then 12 by 12, then 6 by 6, each made by averaging two by two blocks. Circles mark the eyes becoming a smudge and then the whole face disappearing.
svg.text: What downsampling deletes, step by step
Each step averages 2 x 2 blocks into one number. Three quarters of the numbers vanish each time.
